dialogue.content: （こんばんは。相談員役です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I'm playing the counselor. It's a pleasure to work with you today. We'll begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: （ご連絡ありがとうございます。宜しくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for contacting me. I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめてに年齢と性別、今日の相談内容について教えていただけますか。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 30代、女性、将来に不安を感じています
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s, and I'm feeling anxious about the future.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。具体的に将来の不安とはどのようなものがありますか？話しやすいところからでかまいませんのでお話しくださいね。
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me more specifically about your anxieties regarding the future? Please feel free to start with whatever is easiest for you to talk about.

dialogue.content: 旦那と2人の子供がいますが、いつかは別れて1人で育てたいと思っていますが、出来るかどうか悩みます
dialogue.English: I have a husband and two children, but I'm thinking about leaving him and raising them on my own someday. I'm worried about whether I can actually do it.

dialogue.content: ええ。子育てをされながら、旦那さんと別れて育てることを考えているのですね。何か、旦那さんと別れたいきっかけがあったのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I understand. So while raising your children, you're considering separating from your husband and raising them by yourself. Was there something that prompted you to want to leave your husband?

dialogue.content: 下の子をかわいいと思えないと言われました。子供もなついていません
dialogue.English: He told me he doesn't find our younger child cute. The child isn't attached to him either.

dialogue.content: それは辛いお言葉でしたね。
dialogue.English: That must have been very painful to hear.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんから見て旦那さんはどのような方ですか？
dialogue.English: From your perspective, what kind of person is your husband?

dialogue.content: はい。何となくわかっていましたが、やっぱりと思いました
dialogue.English: Yes. I kind of already knew, but hearing it confirmed my suspicions.

dialogue.content: 男性は仕事、女性は家事と育児。男は強くなければならないと思ってます
dialogue.English: He believes that men should work, and women should handle housework and childcare. That men have to be strong.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者さんと旦那さんとの意見の相違があるように感じますがいかかですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It seems like there's a difference of opinion between you and your husband. Would you agree?

dialogue.content: そうですね。共働きなので、手伝って欲しいと思います
dialogue.English: That's right. Since we both work, I wish he would help out.

dialogue.content: 子育てをしながら、旦那さんとのことも考え・・悩みますよね。お子さんはいくつでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It must be difficult, thinking about your husband while also raising your children. How old are your children?

dialogue.content: 4歳と7歳です
dialogue.English: They are four and seven.

dialogue.content: まだまだ小さなお子様もいて、共働きもされているのですね。旦那さんの悩みもですが、色々な事の悩みも尽きませんよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you have young children and you both work. On top of your concerns about your husband, it sounds like you have a lot of other things to worry about as well.

dialogue.content: そうですね。1人でやってけるか不安です。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm worried about whether I can manage on my own.

dialogue.content: これまで、相談者さんは誰かに悩みを相談さたことがありますか。
dialogue.English: Have you ever talked to anyone about these worries before?

dialogue.content: 会社の上司に少し話ました
dialogue.English: I spoke a little with my boss at work.

dialogue.content: たくさんのことを抱えながら不安になることも無理ないと思います。会社の上司の方にお話しされたのですね？相談していかかでしたか？
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable to feel anxious while juggling so much. You mentioned you spoke with your boss at work? How did that go?

dialogue.content: 仕事も頑張って、自立できるようにならないとと思いました
dialogue.English: It made me feel that I need to work hard and become independent.

dialogue.content: 子育てや、お仕事も頑張っておられる姿から一生懸命な姿がうかがえます。
dialogue.English: I can tell you're working very hard, trying your best with both raising your children and your job.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。でも、何もかも上手くいってないように感じます
dialogue.English: Thank you. But I feel like nothing is going well.

dialogue.content: そうお考えなのですね。何かうまくいっていないこと・・が思い当たりますか？
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel. Is there anything specific that comes to mind that's not going well?

dialogue.content: 旦那とは意見があわず喧嘩になるし、会社では失敗ばかりで、嫌になります
dialogue.English: I argue with my husband because we don't see eye to eye, and I keep making mistakes at work. It's making me miserable.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。たくさんの悩みや思いが重なりいっぱいいっぱいになるかと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like a lot of worries and feelings are piling up, and it must feel overwhelming.

dialogue.content: はい。1人でやっていく自信がないので、毎日悩んでいます
dialogue.English: Yes. I don't have the confidence to do it alone, so I worry about it every day.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。毎日頑張られていて、悩むお気持ちも分かります。子育てもあり、大変かと思いますが、休日は何かリフレッシュできることがありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. I can see you're working hard every day, and it's natural to feel worried. With raising children, it must be tough, but do you have anything you do to refresh yourself on your days off?

dialogue.content: そうですね。子どもと公園に行ったりでしょうか。自分だけの時間は、なかなか取れないです。
dialogue.English: Let's see. Maybe going to the park with the children. I don't really get any time for myself.

dialogue.content: なかなか自分の時間もとれないですよね。ずっと色々なことを悩みながら生活し、どれだけ苦しかったでしょうか。相談者さんのために一生懸命考えさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: It's hard to find time for yourself, isn't it? It must have been so difficult, living with all these worries all the time. I will do my very best to help you think things through.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今後のことも含めて、会社の上司の方とお話して少しでも相談者さんのお気持ちは伝えられましたか？
dialogue.English: When you spoke with your boss, including about the future, were you able to convey at least a little of how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: そうですね。上司は応援してくれてますが、気持ちの悩みまでは相談出来ていません
dialogue.English: Well, my boss is supportive, but I haven't been able to talk about my emotional struggles.

dialogue.content: ええ。ずっと気持ちを言えずに苦しい思いをされていたのですね。ここに相談に来ることも勇気がいることだった行動だったと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been suffering, unable to express your feelings for a long time. I think it must have taken a lot of courage to come here and talk today.

dialogue.content: はい。自分がダメなんだと思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: Yes. I end up thinking that I'm the one who's no good.

dialogue.content: そんなことはないですよ。お話をすることはとても勇気がいります。来て頂いてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: That's not true at all. It takes a lot of courage to talk about these things. Thank you for coming.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一番の悩みは、未来の悩みについてでしたが何が一番不安ですか？
dialogue.English: You said your main concern was about the future. What is it that makes you most anxious?

dialogue.content: 漠然とした、未来の見えない不安でしょうか？いかがお考えですか？
dialogue.English: Is it a vague anxiety about an uncertain future? What are your thoughts?

dialogue.content: シングルで2人育てる事は出来るのかという事です。上の子はてんかんがあるので
dialogue.English: It's about whether I can raise two children as a single mother. My older child has epilepsy.

dialogue.content: 行違いましたね、申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: I misunderstood, I apologize.

dialogue.content: 経済的な事や父親がいなくて、大丈夫なのかとか
dialogue.English: Things like finances, and whether they'll be okay without a father.

dialogue.content: 子育てに加えて病気の心配・・。そして、経済的な不安についてもですね。
dialogue.English: In addition to parenting, there's the concern about your child's condition, and financial worries as well.

dialogue.content: はい。頭がごちゃごちゃになります
dialogue.English: Yes. My head gets all jumbled up.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは、子育てしながら仕事もしておられるとのことで寝る時間や食事の時間等は取れていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're working while raising your children. Are you getting enough time to sleep and eat properly?

dialogue.content: 時短で働いているので、寝る時間や食事は子どもに合わせています。
dialogue.English: I work reduced hours, so my sleep and meal times are aligned with my children's schedule.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。やることをしっかりされながら、頑張っておられるのですね。お子さんとの時間は楽しいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you're managing all your responsibilities and working hard. Do you enjoy the time you spend with your children?

dialogue.content: はい。旦那がいなければ。。旦那と4人だと子どもが嫌がるので苦しくてなります
dialogue.English: Yes. If only my husband weren't there... When it's the four of us with him, the children get upset, and it becomes painful for me.

dialogue.content: 旦那さんとの時間が苦しい・・。子どもたちもですが、相談者さんも嫌な何か理由があったりしますか？
dialogue.English: Time with your husband feels painful. Beyond how the children feel, is there anything in particular that makes it difficult for you as well?

dialogue.content: 下の子が男の子で、とても厳しく育てていますが、反対に上の女の子には、何でも許して甘いんです
dialogue.English: He's very strict with our younger child, who is a boy, but conversely, with our older daughter, he lets her get away with anything and is too lenient.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。それは、男の子は特に旦那さんのことが苦手になるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, your son may especially find it hard to be around your husband.

dialogue.content: はい、怖がって泣いてます
dialogue.English: Yes, he's scared and cries.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。それを見ていて、相談者さんはどう思いましたか？
dialogue.English: I understand. How is it for you when you see that?

dialogue.content: 自分の子供が可愛くないのか？と許せなくなりますが、旦那もかわいく思えなくて悩んでいるようです
dialogue.English: I find myself thinking, "Does he not find his own child lovable?" and I feel I can't forgive that. But it seems he's also troubled because he can't feel affection.

dialogue.content: そうお考えなのですね。許せない気持ちと、旦那さんの悩む気持ちもわかるからこそ相談者さんも苦しくなりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be painful for you because you feel you can't forgive him, yet you also understand that your husband is struggling with his own feelings.

dialogue.content: はい。なるべく子供の前では喧嘩しないようにしたいのですが。。
dialogue.English: Yes. I try not to argue in front of the children as much as possible, but...

dialogue.content: 子育てのことで喧嘩になるのですね。喧嘩はしたくないけれども、気持ちが言葉に出てしまう状況でしょうか。
dialogue.English: So you end up arguing about child-rearing. Is it a situation where you don't want to argue, but your feelings just come out as words?

dialogue.content: 子供への接し方が納得行かないと注意して、いい争いになります。
dialogue.English: When I don't agree with how he treats the children, I point it out, and it turns into an argument.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。価値観の行き違いがあると、言い合いになるんですね。子どもたちの前だといけないと・・思いつつも喧嘩になってしまい、それも悩みの１つでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So when there's a difference in values, it leads to arguments. Is the fact that you argue even though you know you shouldn't in front of the children also one of your worries?

dialogue.content: そうですね。あとは、家事、子供の着替えや、送り向かい等、全て私がやってるので、何も手伝ってくれない事もイライラになります
dialogue.English: That's right. Also, I do everything—the housework, getting the kids dressed, taking them to and from places—so it's frustrating that he doesn't help with anything.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。少しでもいいから手伝う姿勢を見せてほしいというところでしょうか。相談者さんの、旦那さん、子育て、お仕事についてたくさん悩まれ、これでも一生懸命な姿と向き合おうとする姿に、心から敬意を表します。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you wish he would at least show a willingness to help, even just a little. I truly respect how you are grappling with so many worries about your husband, child-rearing, and work, and how you are trying so hard to face it all.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。何もしないのに、躾と言ってそこだけ父親みたいにしても、子供も私も受け止めれないんです。
dialogue.English: Thank you. He does nothing to help, but when it comes to discipline, he suddenly acts like a father, and neither the children nor I can accept that.

dialogue.content: 3人で暮らせたらと思ってます
dialogue.English: I wish the three of us could live together.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんもその場面を目の当たりにしてお辛い心中ですね。ここまで、なかなか気持ちをお話したことがなかった・・とお話しされていましたが、少しお話してみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: It must be painful for you to witness those moments. You mentioned that you haven't really been able to talk about your feelings until now... how do you feel after talking a little bit today?

dialogue.content: そうですね。より、自立したいと思って来ました。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's made me want to become independent even more.

dialogue.content: そして、少しすっきりしました
dialogue.English: And I feel a little bit lighter.

dialogue.content: もしかしたら、この相談後も悩むことが出てくるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: You may find that concerns come up again even after this session.

dialogue.content: でも、ここでは、いつでもお話お聴きしますからね。
dialogue.English: But please know that you can always talk to me here anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 子供が義務教育を終えるまで、待った方がよいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: Do you think I should wait until the children finish their compulsory education?

dialogue.content: もし、可能であれば子どもたちの気持ちの状況からお話を進めたり、どうしても・・。の時は早い段階で考える必要があるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: If possible, it might be good to proceed based on how your children are feeling, but if things become unbearable... you may need to consider it sooner.

dialogue.content: そうですね。。子供と話ながら考えてみます
dialogue.English: You're right... I'll think about it while talking with my children.

dialogue.content: また、状況をお話をしながら今後も一緒に考えていけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: As the situation unfolds, I hope we can keep talking and continue thinking it through together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 何事にも一生懸命な相談者さんだからこそ、少しでも休めるときに休んでおいしいものを食べて元気で過ごしてほしいと感じました。
dialogue.English: Because you work so hard at everything, I truly hope you can rest when you get a chance, eat something delicious, and take care of yourself.

dialogue.content: 疲れもあるかと思いますので、この後はお風呂に浸かったり、好きな音楽やいい匂いを嗅いだりリラックスできる時間をお過ごしくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm sure you're tired, so after this, please take some time to relax, maybe by taking a bath, listening to your favorite music, or enjoying a pleasant scent.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。私は子育ても仕事も出来ないと思ってましたが、子供を守る気持ちはあると感じました。自分の事も大切にしたいと思います
dialogue.English: Thank you. I used to think I couldn't manage parenting or work, but I realized I do have the desire to protect my children. I also want to take care of myself.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 素敵なお考えですね。自分のことも大切にお過ごしくださいね。本日はありがとうございました。それではこれで終了します。
dialogue.English: That's a wonderful thought. Please do take care of yourself. Thank you for your time today. This concludes our session.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうこざいました
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ロープレお疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play session. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （お手隙に評価を頂けたら幸いです。よろしくお願いいたします。それでは終了いたします。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (I would appreciate it if you could leave a review when you have a moment. Thank you. I will now end the session. Thank you again.)

dialogue.content: （かしこまりました）
dialogue.English: (Understood.)
